detail: Transcribed 2026-09-02 from tactic-mainqa-dispatch-daemon-restart (git archive holds the full node; serves strategy-autonomous-execution). Park reason: observable only on the next real claude-code flake bump and home-manager activation on the live WSL host; migrated 2026-07-05 from the legacy gh main-qa office-hours queue. Checklist: (1) Restart onto the new store path (was 2757) — after a nix flake update bumping claude-code plus activation, sd-switch restarts dispatch-claude-daemon.service onto the new store path, a freshly forked background session reports the new version, and no manual restart is needed. (2) No gratuitous restart (was 2756) — a home-manager activation that does not change the claude-code store path leaves the daemon running (unit bytes unchanged, so no sd-switch restart and no fleet reap); the stable-anchor PATH design gives this statically, so what is owed is the runtime behavior across two real activations. This is the standing remedy for the recurring stale-daemon failure mode where background sessions run the old claude-code binary until a manual systemctl --user restart.
subject: mainqa (author-required): Verify dispatch-claude-daemon auto-restart semantics live — restarts onto the new store path on a claude-code flake bump, no gratuitous restart on unrelated activations
